changed_values.before: The ground shudders in slow, heavy beats from the {0}. Something enormous is walking this way, and it does not live here.\n\nWhatever it is will cross the map. Anything built in its path may not survive it.
changed_values.after: The ground shudders in slow, heavy beats from the {0}. Something enormous is coming in from beyond the map.\n\nWhatever it is will cross the map. Anything built in its path may not survive it.

changed_values.before: A titan (size tier 2 or 3) that lives in some other biome, never this map's own, may cross your map edge to edge. Hours of footfall tremors (screen shake and messages) come first; then it walks across, and its wake smashes what is built in its path. Never two of the largest tier on one map. Off: the event never fires.
changed_values.after: A titan (size tier 2 or 3) may walk in from beyond your map and cross it edge to edge. This map's biome decides which titans can come: those it lists for passage or, if it lists none, those from its own wild animal roster. Hours of footfall tremors (screen shake and messages) come first; then it walks across, and its wake smashes what is built in its path. Never two of the largest tier on one map. Off: the event never fires.
